# Volatile functions of pg_catalog (PostgreSQL 14 to 18) reviewed and allowed in restricted mode, one "name reason"
# line each. The denied ones are in internal/safesql/denylist.go. TestCatalogVolatileClassified fails on a volatile
# function that is in neither: classify it after checking what it does inside a READ ONLY transaction.

# Trigger and language support: they fail unless called by the trigger manager or the function manager.
RI_FKey_cascade_del trigger function
RI_FKey_cascade_upd trigger function
RI_FKey_check_ins trigger function
RI_FKey_check_upd trigger function
RI_FKey_noaction_del trigger function
RI_FKey_noaction_upd trigger function
RI_FKey_restrict_del trigger function
RI_FKey_restrict_upd trigger function
RI_FKey_setdefault_del trigger function
RI_FKey_setdefault_upd trigger function
RI_FKey_setnull_del trigger function
RI_FKey_setnull_upd trigger function
suppress_redundant_updates_trigger trigger function
tsvector_update_trigger trigger function
tsvector_update_trigger_column trigger function
unique_key_recheck trigger function
plpgsql_call_handler language handler, cannot be called from SQL
plpgsql_validator compiles a function body, writes nothing
amvalidate checks an operator class against the catalog

# Random values, clock and session-local state.
array_sample random
array_shuffle random
gen_random_uuid random
random random
random_normal random
uuidv4 random
uuidv7 random and clock
setseed seed of random() in this session
clock_timestamp clock
timeofday clock
timezone current time zone of the session
current_query text of the current statement
pg_sleep bounded by statement_timeout
pg_sleep_for bounded by statement_timeout
pg_sleep_until bounded by statement_timeout
pg_stat_clear_snapshot discards this session's statistics snapshot
pg_stat_force_next_flush flushes this session's own statistics

# Sequences: nextval and setval fail in a read-only transaction.
currval reads this session's last value
lastval reads this session's last value
nextval refused by READ ONLY
setval refused by READ ONLY
pg_get_sequence_data reads a sequence
pg_sequence_last_value reads a sequence

# Sizes and object information.
pg_database_size reads sizes
pg_indexes_size reads sizes
pg_relation_size reads sizes
pg_table_size reads sizes
pg_tablespace_size reads sizes
pg_total_relation_size reads sizes
pg_partition_ancestors reads the catalog
pg_partition_tree reads the catalog
pg_collation_actual_version reads the collation provider
pg_database_collation_actual_version reads the collation provider
currtid2 reads a row version

# Transactions, locks and snapshots.
pg_blocking_pids reads the lock table
pg_safe_snapshot_blocking_pids reads the lock table
pg_isolation_test_session_is_blocked reads the lock table
pg_lock_status reads the lock table
pg_export_snapshot exports this transaction's snapshot, read-only
pg_prepared_xact reads prepared transactions
pg_get_multixact_members reads a multixact
pg_last_committed_xact reads commit timestamps
pg_xact_commit_timestamp reads commit timestamps
pg_xact_commit_timestamp_origin reads commit timestamps
pg_xact_status reads a transaction status
txid_status reads a transaction status
pg_notification_queue_usage reads the NOTIFY queue size

# Server state, WAL and recovery.
pg_control_checkpoint reads pg_control
pg_control_init reads pg_control
pg_control_recovery reads pg_control
pg_control_system reads pg_control
pg_current_wal_flush_lsn reads a WAL position
pg_current_wal_insert_lsn reads a WAL position
pg_current_wal_lsn reads a WAL position
pg_last_wal_receive_lsn reads a WAL position
pg_last_wal_replay_lsn reads a WAL position
pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp reads replay progress
pg_get_wal_replay_pause_state reads replay state
pg_is_wal_replay_paused reads replay state
pg_is_in_recovery reads recovery state
pg_is_in_backup reads backup state
pg_get_wal_resource_managers lists WAL resource managers
pg_available_wal_summaries lists WAL summaries
pg_get_wal_summarizer_state reads WAL summarizer state
pg_wal_summary_contents reads a WAL summary
pg_show_replication_origin_status reads replication origins
pg_jit_available reads JIT availability
pg_get_aios reads asynchronous I/O state
pg_get_backend_memory_contexts reads this session's memory
pg_get_loaded_modules lists loaded libraries
pg_get_shmem_allocations reads shared memory
pg_get_shmem_allocations_numa reads shared memory
pg_get_wait_events lists wait events
pg_current_logfile name of the current log file, not its content
pg_hba_file_rules parsed pg_hba.conf, superuser or granted only
pg_ident_file_mappings parsed pg_ident.conf, superuser or granted only
pg_show_all_file_settings parsed configuration files, superuser or granted only

# Statistics readers.
pg_stat_get_backend_io reads statistics
pg_stat_get_backend_wal reads statistics
pg_stat_get_io reads statistics
pg_stat_get_recovery_prefetch reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_blocks_fetched reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_blocks_hit reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_function_calls reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_function_self_time reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_function_total_time reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_numscans reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_deleted reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_fetched reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_hot_updated reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_inserted reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_newpage_updated reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_returned reads statistics
pg_stat_get_xact_tuples_updated reads statistics
pg_stat_have_stats reads statistics
